TASK. This paper argues that proximity design inherits an induced-interface floor from degrader work. Its load-bearing move is a **transfer**: a quantity or constraint established in one system is carried into another. For each such transfer:

1. Quote the sentence that performs it.
2. Identify the source system the number or constraint actually comes from, by reading the cited artifact or record.
3. Verdict: SUPPORTED AT THE STATED LEVEL, OVERSTATED (say exactly what the source supports instead), MISATTRIBUTED (the cited record does not own it), or NO SOURCE LOCATED.

The failure mode to hunt: a **floor** or **threshold** asserted as general when the source establishes it only for the specific system, ligand class or assay it was measured or computed in; and a **computed** interface quantity presented as a **measured** one. Separately, check every numeric quantity in the main text against the committed artifact leaf that should hold it and report MATCH / MISMATCH (both values) / NO SOURCE LOCATED with the exact key path you read. Check the supplement and the sizing note only as sources for the main paper's claims — the main paper is your subject.

For every defect, propose EXACT replacement text as a single-occurrence string replacement (old verbatim, new verbatim) so the parent can apply it mechanically. Apply nothing yourself.

PROHIBITIONS: author, propose as code, or apply no repair, patch, gate or test. Do not weaken, relax or reorder any guard. Do not run `scripts/preflight.sh`, any producer, or any figure generator. No network retrieval, no paid API, no GPU, no publication. Do not reopen or retry any closed source route. Do not read, audit, extend or reference `reports/W25-*` or any W25 continuation. Contact no humans.

SCIENTIFIC INTEGRITY (binding): no invented facts, sources, patient data, clinical efficacy/safety/therapeutic-window claims or test results. Distinguish primary evidence, prediction, association and experimental validation; preserve provenance and negative findings. Preregistrations are immutable. There is no wet lab: make no EMC efficacy, safety, selectivity or clinical-readiness claim, and do not let one into the prose. Absence of a located source is NOT evidence a claim is false — say NO SOURCE LOCATED and stop there. An approximation marker matters: "~5 kcal/mol" is not falsified by a source value of 5.3, so report such cases as precision refinements rather than as numeric errors. If any request of yours is refused by content policy, STOP that branch, record the refusal verbatim, and never route around it.

Your verdict is specific to THIS paper. Do not generalise to the repository and do not run a broad census.

Stop condition: every transfer and every main-text quantity has a verdict, or ~45 tool calls, whichever comes first. Returning early is a success; padding is not.

Report entirely in your final message text. Headings: Worker / Question / Method and inputs / Transfer table with verdicts / Quantity table with verdicts / Defects found, with exact proposed replacements / Limitations / Stop condition / Tool-call count actually used.

## github
The GitHub MCP Server provides tools to interact with GitHub platform.

Tool selection guidance:
	1. Use 'list_*' tools for broad, simple retrieval and pagination of all items of a type (e.g., all issues, all PRs, all branches) with basic filtering.
	2. Use 'search_*' tools for targeted queries with specific criteria, keywords, or complex filters (e.g., issues with certain text, PRs by author, code containing functions).

Context management:
	1. Use pagination whenever possible with batches of 5-10 items.
	2. Use minimal_output parameter set to true if the full information is not needed to accomplish a task.

    15	# The induced-interface floor that proximity design inherits from degraders is about twice the interface of the one solved transcriptional CIP
    16	
    17	**Preprint draft — not submitted, not posted.**
    18	
    19	> **Role: the manuscript for publication endpoint
    20	> [`PUB-TCIP`](../../../systems/views/L3-publications.md).** Every number is read at write time from the
    21	> artifact that owns it: the geometric enumeration from
    22	> [`nr4a3-tcip-reach.json`](../../modalities/nr4a3-tcip-reach.json), the structural census from
    23	> [`nr4a3-induced-interface-census.json`](../../modalities/nr4a3-induced-interface-census.json) with its
    24	> decision view [`tcip-interface-floor-sizing.md`](./tcip-interface-floor-sizing.md). This manuscript
    25	> adds no measurement of its own. Methods and full tables: [SI](./tcip-induced-interface-preprint-si.md).
    26	
    27	> ⛔ **THIS IS A MODALITY-GENERAL PARAMETER RESULT, NOT A DISEASE-SPECIFIC ONE.** The enumeration was
    28	> computed in an EWSR1::NR4A3 setting because that is the program it arose in, and **that is the
    29	> setting, not the claim**. Both load-bearing structural results are free of NR4A3 entirely: the
    30	> 6–7-contact measurement is on a BCL6·p300 lymphoma system, and the calibration is over published
    31	> degrader/glue ternaries, none of them NR4A3. Nothing here is evidence about any disease.
    32	
    33	---
    34	
    35	## Abstract
    36	
    37	Chemically induced proximity is increasingly designed with tooling built for targeted protein
    38	degradation. That tooling carries a parameter most users never see: a minimum induced-interface size,
    39	below which a candidate placement is scored as a tethered pair rather than a complex. The parameter is
    40	a **degrader's** requirement — a PROTAC must build a cooperative target·E3 interface across which
    41	ubiquitin is transferred — and it is applied unchanged when the recruited partner is a transcriptional
    42	effector instead of a ligase.
    43	
    44	We show that this inherited floor, and not steric bulk, produces the apparent geometric penalty against
    45	smaller second termini. In a paired rigid-body enumeration run from identical anchors, single-domain
    46	bodies accept **0.896×** the orientation space of multi-subunit bodies at the committed floor; ablating
    47	the floor inverts the ratio to **1.254×**. On excluded volume alone the smaller body gets *more*
    48	orientation space, not less.
    49	
    50	We then size the floor against deposited structures. Measured under the sampler's own contact predicate
    51	across 22 entries, the **only deposited chemically-induced transcriptional-proximity complex** — the
    52	chemically hijacked BCL6·TCIP3·p300 complex, PDB 9MZA, X-ray 2.1 Å — presents an induced interface of
    53	**6–7 contact points across 4 residues per side**, in both crystallographically independent copies.
    54	The committed floor is **12**, so the real transcriptional CIP fails it in both directions by roughly a
    55	factor of two. Applied to the modality it was actually written for, the same floor rejects **6 of 15**
    56	solved degrader/molecular-glue ternaries, including MZ1·BRD4-BD2·pVHL at **10–11**.
    57	
    58	**What this does not establish.** It does not establish a lower limit on induced-interface size, a
    59	monotone relationship between interface size and transcriptional output, or any threshold below which
    60	such a system stops working: the structural bound is **n = 1 system in one crystal form and bounds the
    61	floor from above only**. It does not establish that the apparent size penalty is real — a within-class
    62	control refutes it, since the spread between two bodies of the *same* size exceeds the between-class
    63	contrast at **8 of 8** rungs, so the pooled contrast is confounded and may not be reported as a size
    64	law. The geometric test reports whether a body is *admitted* by excluded volume, a gate no tested body
    65	has ever failed — including a 1 183-residue CRBN–DDB1 assembly — so admitting refutes nothing on its
    66	own; and the bodies are isolated ligand-binding or BTB domains with no DNA and no chromatin, making any
    67	admitting answer an **upper** bound. It establishes nothing about binding, potency, selectivity,
    68	transcriptional output, efficacy, safety, therapeutic window or clinical readiness, and it is not a
    69	disease-specific result. The selectivity requirement for this modality is **not** smaller than a
    70	degrader's, and its anti-target ceiling has no candidate source.
    71	
    72	---
    73	
    74	## 1 · The parameter nobody re-derived
    75	
    76	A bivalent molecule that recruits a transcriptional effector to a target — a transcriptional chemical
    77	inducer of proximity, TCIP — is geometrically a PROTAC with the ligase swapped out. That similarity is
    78	why proximity-design tooling transfers to it, and it is also the trap.
    79	
    80	Rigid-body proximity samplers score a candidate placement on excluded volume plus a **minimum induced
    81	interface**. In the sampler used here the parameter is `min_contact_residues = 12`, carrying the comment
    82	*"below this it is a tethered pair, not an interface"*. The justification is a degrader's: ubiquitin
    83	transfer requires a cooperative, buried target·E3 interface, and a placement that merely holds two
    84	proteins near each other will not deliver it.
    85	
    86	A TCIP's productive event is not ubiquitin transfer. Whether it requires a comparable induced interface,
    87	a smaller one, or a different quantity altogether had not been established. The requirement is properly
    88	a **residence time** at an occupied locus; a contact count is a proxy for it whose calibration constant
    89	is a property of the recruited partner's mechanism, and the degrader's constant may not be inherited.
    90	
    91	This paper does not size that requirement. It shows what the inherited parameter **costs**, and it
    92	bounds the floor from above with a real structure.
    93	
    94	## 2 · The sign inverts across the floor
    95	
    96	We ran a paired rigid-body enumeration: six staged bodies, identical warhead anchors, an identical
    97	target frame, an identical distance field, and one linker-length ladder — 576 cells at 300 000 samples
    98	each. Two bodies are single-domain E3 recruiters (`birc2`, 92 residues; `mdm2`, 94), two are
    99	multi-subunit E3s (`crbn`, 1 183; `vhl`, 340). Pooled acceptance by size class is the paired contrast.
   100	
   101	At the committed floor the single-domain pool accepts **less** orientation space than the multi-subunit
   102	pool at every rung. Taken alone that reads as *"an effector-size terminus is geometrically harder"* —
   103	the opposite of the intuition that a smaller second terminus is a smaller problem.
   104	
   105	**Re-running the identical cells with only the interface floor changed inverts it.**
   106	
   107	| `min_contact_residues` | single-domain | multi-subunit | ratio |
   108	|---|---|---|---|
   109	| **12 (committed)** | 0.000810 | 0.000904 | **0.896** |
   110	| 6 | 0.008771 | 0.007822 | **1.121** |
   111	| **0 (pure steric)** | 0.080079 | 0.063875 | **1.254** |
   112	
   113	*(12-atom linker rung, 30 000 samples per arm per pose;
   114	[`nr4a3-tcip-reach.json`](../../modalities/nr4a3-tcip-reach.json) → `★_interface_floor_ablation`.)*
   115	
   116	On excluded volume alone the smaller body gets **25 % more** admissible orientation space. The entire
   117	measured penalty is the induced-interface requirement, and it is monotone in the floor. The result
   118	reproduces at two sample counts and across a determinism fix (SI §S1).
   119	
   120	**So a TCIP scored at the committed floor is charged for an induced interface nobody has shown the
   121	modality needs.** Which floor is correct is not settled by this ablation, and the enumeration declines

   123	both.

   126

   134	⇒ **Body size is not the controlling variable; the individual body's shape and exit-vector geometry

   136	across the floor**, which is a statement about the parameter and is measured on the same bodies in both

   140	
   141	If a real chemically-induced *transcriptional* complex exists whose induced interface is smaller than
   142	the floor, the floor is not a necessary property of induced proximity.
   143	
   144	22 deposited entries were measured under the sampler's own predicate — the same three distance bands
   145	and the same query points the placement loop uses
   146	([`nr4a3-induced-interface-census.json`](../../modalities/nr4a3-induced-interface-census.json)). Because
   147	the predicate is one-sided — an arm is sampled against a target, not the reverse — every pair is
   148	measured **both ways** and both numbers are reported; no orientation is promoted.
   149	
   150	**PDB 9MZA** — *"Chemically Hijacked BCL6–TCIP3–p300 Complex"*, X-ray **2.1 Å** — is the only deposited
   151	chemically-induced transcriptional-proximity complex found. Its induced BCL6·p300 interface measures:
   152	
   153	| copy | contact points (both directions) | residues with a contact point, per side |
   154	|---|---|---|
   155	| A/D | **6 / 7** | 4 and 4 |
   156	| B/C | **7 / 6** | 4 and 4 |
   157	
   158	**6–7 contact points across 4 residues per side, identical in both crystallographically independent
   159	copies, failing the floor of 12 in both directions by roughly a factor of two.**
   160	
   161	**Two controls make that number mean what it says.**
   162	
   163	*Saturation.* The same predicate, in the same coordinate file, reads the constitutive BCL6 BTB
   164	homodimer at **66–71** contact points across 39–42 residues per side; in the independent 7LWG crystal

   166	magnitude above the induced one — so the small number is a property of the interface, not of the
   167	instrument.
   168	
   169	*Truncation.* Both partners are substantially resolved: the BCL6 chains contribute 122–123 residues

   172	33–42 atoms' worth of each partner — a large molecule creating a tiny protein–protein interface.

   176	The floor is a degrader's parameter. Measured against 15 solved degrader/molecular-glue induced pairs,

   180	A threshold that would reject a substantial share of its own modality's solved ternaries is not a
   181	calibrated requirement being applied outside its range; it is an uncalibrated one. This is a statement
   182	about the parameter and **not** a claim about whether those degraders work — they demonstrably do.
   183	
   184	## 5 · What this does not establish
   185	
   186	Stated plainly, because each has a specific and non-obvious reach.
   187	
   188	1. **The structural bound bounds from ABOVE only.** It shows the floor is not necessary. It does **not**
   189	   establish a lower limit, a monotone size-to-output relationship, or a threshold below which such a
   190	   system stops working. **n = 1 system, one crystal form**; two crystallographically independent copies
   191	   are not two systems.
   192	2. **"Admits" is an excluded-volume statement, and no tested body has ever failed it** — including a
   193	   1 183-residue CRBN–DDB1 assembly. A gate that cannot fail carries no information when it passes.
   194	3. **The bodies are isolated ligand-binding or BTB domains, not proteins**, with no DNA and no
   195	   chromatin. Any admitting answer is therefore an **upper** bound on what a nucleus would allow.
   196	4. **One staged body is not comparable and is not pooled.** `brd4_bd1`'s exit-atom exposure is 13.65 Å,
   197	   outside the committed E3 range of 5.00–5.79 Å; `bcl6` at 5.44 Å is inside. `brd4_bd1`'s acceptance
   198	   may not be pooled with or ranked against the others, and it is excluded from every pooled figure.
   199	5. **The named-effector result is narrower than it looks.** `bcl6` (7LWG, 243 residues) and `brd4_bd1`
   200	   (4ZC9, 127) admit at every rung down to a 6-atom linker. But the paired size comparison, the
   201	   within-class control and the floor ablation are computed on the **four committed bodies only**;
   202	   `birc2` and `mdm2` remain size-and-shape proxies there, and nothing about a named effector may be
   203	   read off them. The ablation is a statement about the sampler's inherited parameter, not about any
   204	   effector.
   205	6. **The selectivity requirement is not smaller here.** It needs the same odds-product difference in
   206	   induced-complex-fraction space that a degrader needs, and its anti-target ceiling has **no candidate
   207	   source**. Recruiting an effector rather than a ligase does not relax it.
   208	7. **No biological claim whatsoever.** Nothing here says any effector binds any target, is recruited, is
   209	   retained on chromatin, or changes transcription. No binding, potency, selectivity, efficacy, safety,
   210	   therapeutic-window or clinical claim is made or implied, for any molecule whose structure is measured
   211	   here.
   212	8. **This is not a disease-specific result.** The setting in which the enumeration was computed is not
   213	   part of the claim.
   214	
   215	### 5a · What would settle it
   216	
   217	A **series**: two or more induced interfaces of different size, within one transcriptional system, with
   218	matched transcriptional output. That is what converts a bound into a calibration curve, and no such
   219	series exists for any transcriptional CIP — the modality's literature does not characterise its own
   220	induced interface (SI §S7). Building one is wet-lab work.
   221	
   222	## 6 · A discrepancy inside the parameter itself
   223	
   224	`min_contact_residues` reads as a count of residues. The placement loop does not count residues: it
   225	iterates a query set built as **two points per residue** — the CA and the side-chain centroid — and
   226	increments per **point**. It is also a three-band `if/elif` chain, so a probe scores as contact only in
   227	the shell between the soft-clash and contact radii; closer than that it is a clash. The committed floor
   228	of 12 is therefore **12 points, as few as 6 residues**, not 12 residues.
   229	
   230	We do not resolve which reading was intended, and the conclusion does not need it: the headline
   231	comparison is like-for-like on both sides — **6–7 points against a 12-point floor**, or **4 residues per
   232	side against a floor of at most 6 residues' worth of probes**. Roughly half either way.
   233	
   234	## 7 · Methods, in one paragraph
   235	
   236	Geometry: rigid-body enumeration from fixed warhead exit-vector anchors against a target distance field,
   237	with acceptance on hard clash, a soft-clash budget and the interface floor; 576 cells at 300 000 samples
   238	for the paired comparison, 30 000 per arm per pose for the ablation. Structures: mmCIF fetched in CI
   239	from `files.rcsb.org`, parsed with a pure-stdlib reader; every entry verified from its own `_struct.title`
   240	and `_entity.pdbx_description` rather than from its accession, so a mis-remembered identifier surfaces as
   241	a mismatched title rather than as a number attributed to the wrong complex. Both analyses are
   242	deterministic and offline. Full methods, tables and controls: [SI](./tcip-induced-interface-preprint-si.md).

## S7 · Why no calibration curve exists — the literature, counted

Two Europe PMC sweeps, both run in CI, establish that the absence of a size-to-output relationship for
transcriptional proximity is a property of the field rather than of this search.

**(a) The modality-wide sweep.** *Induced proximity / chemically induced dimerization / chemical inducer
of proximity / TCIP* **AND** *transcription / transcriptional / gene expression / transcription factor*
returned **100 records, 20 with open-access full text**. Across all 20 full texts the terms *buried
surface area*, *interface area*, *contact residue*, *structure of the ternary/induced complex* and
*residence time* occur **0 times**; `cooperativit*` occurs in one file, twice.

**(b) The asymmetry against degraders, measured rather than asserted.** *Cooperativity / residence time /
buried surface area / interface area* **AND** *induced proximity / molecular glue / PROTAC / ternary
complex / degrader* returned **300 records, 51 with open-access full text**. Of those 51, **31** pair an
interface property with a **degradation** readout; **6** pair one with anything transcription-shaped, and
none of those six relates interface size to transcriptional output.

⇒ **The field routinely relates the induced interface to output when the output is degradation, and does
not when it is transcription.** That asymmetry is why the floor was inheritable in one direction and
unsized in the other, and it is what makes a single deposited transcriptional structure worth this much.

Six bodies are staged from deposited coordinates and placed by rigid-body Monte Carlo from **fixed
warhead exit-vector anchors** against a target distance field. A placement is accepted when it has no
hard clash, no more than the permitted soft clashes, and at least `min_contact_residues` query points in

process, so the artifact did not reproduce between runs. Fixed to `zlib.crc32` and verified: two full

## Limitations

- **Scope.** This verdict is specific to `tcip-induced-interface-preprint.md` at HEAD `dddf2fb9`. I ran no repository census and generalise nothing to other manuscripts.
- **No source located ≠ false.** Two items — the discarded re-implementation's "7 of 15" and "62–64" (App. A(2)), and the EuropePMC `"9MZA"` hitCount 0 (App. B) — have no source I could locate in the artifacts, SI, sizing note, route memo or citation gate. - **I opened no external link and verified no accession.** Every PDB identifier, DOI, PMID and resolution is checked only against committed bytes. Whether 9MZA, the bioRxiv DOI or the Cell DOI resolve is UNKNOWN from here.
- **I did not re-run any producer**, so I did not verify that `nr4a3-tcip-reach.json` or the census reproduce from their generators; I read them as committed. Numeric agreement between prose and artifact says nothing about whether the artifact is current with its code.
- **The instrument, not the biology.** Every "contact point" in this paper is a count under one specific predicate (CA + side-chain centroid, ≤6.0 Å, three-band). I verified the paper discloses that predicate; I did not and could not assess whether it is the right predicate for an induced interface.
